caption:
RUPEE HITS 7-MONTH HIGH BELOW 93 AGAINST DOLLAR

The rupee surged to a 7‑month high, closing at 92.67 per dollar and touching an intraday high of 92.91, moving back below the 93 level for the first time since April 2026. This marks five consecutive sessions of appreciation and a weekly gain of over ₹1.
The move is driven by sustained overseas investments, foreign portfolio inflows and softer crude oil prices, reflecting improving sentiment in domestic equities and easing import costs.

For information only. Not investment advice.
